rav-beivai.name: Rav Beivai
rav-beivai.bio: Babylonian Amora, cited in the Talmud as Rav Beivai (Rav Bivi).
rav-beivai.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying dark beard and a plain brown wool mantle, a finger resting on an open scroll as he sets two verses side by side; background of mudbrick academy walls lit by oil lamps.
